name: spatial_v1
hypothesis: Frozen native-resolution PixelSeal spatial features retain localization evidence discarded by global bit pooling; a learned context head can exploit it alongside Adobe features.
model: Adobe ResNet body frozen, FPN trainable; PixelSeal ConvNeXt frozen at native 256 with four 8-channel projections; modest 32/48/64/96 context head with dropout 0.1
optimization: Existing AdamW: FPN 5e-5, new head 0.002, weight decay 1e-4, cosine schedule; BCE plus two-class soft Dice
augmentation: Existing joint dihedral transforms of image, guide and truth; no synthetic samples in this experiment
selection: Checkpoint at epoch 1 and multiples of 5, threshold grid 0.2..0.8 step 0.05; per-method inner tune only
promotion: All five paired fold gains positive; overall mean gain >=0.002; conditional paired bootstrap 99% lower bound >0, seed20261126 and20000resamples
public_leaderboard: Never used for tuning, checkpoint selection or promotion gate
limitations: Reused development images and unknown source identities; image bootstrap excludes architecture-selection uncertainty; no guarantee against overfitting
